create_parser: create a CLI argument parser with engine args and sampling parameters for vLLM offline inference
create_main_inference: create a main function that initializes an LLM, configures sampling params, and generates text from prompts
create_llm_generate: create an LLM instance and call generate with a list of prompts and sampling parameters to produce text outputs
create_sampling_params: create sampling parameters from LLM defaults and override max_tokens, temperature, top_p, and top_k
create_llm_engine: create an LLM engine with EngineArgs CLI arguments and a default model for offline text generation
